evidence: Matthews has also established a cross-functional Artificial Intelligence ("AI") Council to ensure that artificial intelligence is used legally, ethically, effectively, and commercially successfully across its business.
The Matthews AI Council serves as an extension of its cybersecurity program with a specific focus on artificial intelligence systems.

Notwithstanding the vigorous approach Matthews takes to cybersecurity, the Company may not always be successful in preventing or mitigating a cybersecurity incident that could have a material adverse effect on it.
ai_positioning.summary: Matthews adopte une approche défensive et gouvernée de l'IA, avec un AI Council axé sur la conformité légale, l'éthique et la sécurité, plutôt que sur l'innovation ou le déploiement commercial de solutions IA.
